title: Chapter 127 Deserted City Is So Terrifying
content:
Chapter 127 Deserted City Is So Terrifying

However, most of them were basically indifferent and indifferent.

They were helpless about this.

And now, Tianlin Star Region has fallen.

It's their turn for Huoling Star Region.

Just when they were a little desperate, a breath suddenly appeared outside the hall.

Everyone was shocked.

The next moment, a familiar figure appeared in front of everyone.

It was the old man who was the leader of Hun Gu Star Region before.

"With our current strength, it is basically impossible to fight against the Divine Dynasty. It is only a matter of time before we are destroyed."

As soon as he entered the hall, the old man said directly.

Hearing this, everyone frowned.

Yan Yan said in a deep voice: "So what should we do? You come here, not just to say sarcastic words, right?"

The old man sneered and continued: "Doesn't this Divine Dynasty want to destroy us and merge with his Divine Dynasty? If so, we will not do as they wish."

"What do you mean?"

Yan Yan was a little confused at this moment.

"Huangcheng, have you heard of this force?"

Hearing this, Yan Yan was slightly stunned.

The elder beside him said: "Master, I know that it is a force a little far from us, and its strength seems to be very strong."

"Very strong?"

Yan Yan looked at the elder beside him, "How strong?"

At this time, the old man said directly: "Not very strong, but very strong. I have investigated. This force, in the open, has several God Emperor Realm powerhouses, and there is also a super God Realm powerhouse swordsman."

As soon as these words came out, the whole hall suddenly became silent, and you could hear a pin drop.

After a long time, Yan Yan recovered.

"You, are you telling the truth?"

How come he has never heard of such a powerful force.

The old man nodded and said: "What I said is all true, and this is only the power on the surface. In the dark, I don't know how many powerful people are hidden."

Suddenly, Yan Yan was silent.

He already understood what the old man meant.

That is to say, join the Desolate City. A force of that level is estimated to be the same as the Divine Dynasty, and will not be willing to form an alliance with them. Therefore, if you want to join the Desolate City, the only way is to become a subsidiary force of the other party.

In that case, it is no different from directly surrendering to the Divine Dynasty.

The only benefit is that you can disgust the Divine Dynasty.

After a long silence, Yan Yan looked up and said, "Is there really no other way?"

The old man shook his head.

"The Divine Dynasty is not something we can deal with. We can only withdraw from this fight in advance."

"However,"

The old man sneered.

"We join the Desolate City and expand the strength of the Desolate City. At that time, do you think it will be interesting if the Desolate City fights with the Divine Dynasty?"

In the end, Yan Yan agreed to this suggestion.

This is also the only way.

Soon, Yan Yan and the old man left the Fire Spirit Star Region together, broke through the void, and headed north.

.........

Xuanling Star Region, Desolate City.

In the City Lord's Mansion, a figure stood in the sword tower with a long sword in hand.

It was Huang Shou.

At this moment, Huang Shou's aura had reached the realm of super god.

Around him, endless mysterious sword intent was constantly circling. Huang Shou closed his eyes slightly and was contemplating it with his heart.

Buzz——

A unique sword intent suddenly stood out from countless sword intents, and suddenly, the aura of this sword intent began to rise continuously.

The next moment, countless sword intents gathered towards that sword intent.

That sword intent was Huang Shou's sword intent!

Outside the sword tower.

Several figures were standing here.

Ouyang Yanqing looked at the figure in the sword tower, and her expression moved slightly.

After so many years, she still hadn't caught up with this guy.

Once, she thought it was because the other party joined Huangcheng one step earlier than her.

So she had always lagged behind the other party.

And now, she finally understood.

Huang Shou, this guy, is really powerful.

She has been a little too persistent over the years.

After thinking it through, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly smiled.

At this moment, she finally achieved the state of mind communication.

Click!

A sound rang out from her body, and the next moment, a sacred breath slowly overflowed from her body.

Boom!

Ouyang Yanqing's breath became more and more terrifying, and Ah Wei and Gu Chen, who were eating melons on the side, were stunned.

What the hell is going on?

He reached the super god realm after just a few glances?

At this time, Ouyang Yanqing had already broken through to the super god realm.

Feeling the power in her body far beyond the past, Ouyang Yanqing smiled, and then Ouyang Yanqing soared directly into the sky.

The breath of the super god realm suddenly poured from the center of the deserted city to all directions.

For a while, the entire Xuanling star field was a little shaken.

Outside the Xuanling star field.

Yan Yan and the others who had just arrived at the border were stunned.

Feeling the powerful breath of the super god realm, Yan Yan looked solemn.

"Is this the super god realm expert?"

However, the old man on the side was stunned, "No, that super god realm is not this, there is indeed more than one super god realm expert in this deserted city!"

Hearing this, Yan Yan immediately took a breath of cold air.

This deserted city is even more terrifying than imagined.

Suddenly, the two of them became more confident about what was to come.

At this time, above the deserted city, Ouyang Yanqing stretched out his arms, venting his emotions over the years.

In one word, cool!

At this moment, a terrifying sword intent suddenly rose from the sword tower.

Boom!

In an instant, the entire void was shattered.

Seeing this terrifying sword intent, Ouyang Yanqing was slightly stunned and quickly made way.

"Miss Ouyang, sorry, please make way for me first, it's my turn to pretend."

Huang Shou's voice sounded from the sword tower.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing rolled her eyes and smiled, "Okay, okay."

Then Ouyang Yanqing fell below and returned to the side of A Wei and the others.

"Congratulations, Miss Ouyang, for breaking through the super god realm."

The two saw Ouyang Yanqing and said in unison.

Ouyang Yanqing nodded and looked up at the void.

I saw that Huang Shou had stepped into the void and came to the sky without knowing when.

At the same time, a terrifying and suffocating sword intent suddenly surged out of Huang Shou's body, and then covered the entire Xuanling Star Region!

The sword intent is divine!

Instantly, all the practitioners looked towards the direction of the deserted city again.

The Sword God, it turned out to be the legendary Sword God!

Buzz——

At this moment, all the swords in the entire Xuanling Star Region suddenly soared into the sky, pointing to the direction of the deserted city, and the sound of swords continued, all of which were worshiping the Sword God!

At the border of the Xuanling Star Region, Yan Yan and the others felt the terrifying sword intent in front of them, and suddenly showed an extremely bitter smile.

"Brother, I am short-sighted. Is this the sword intent that reaches the gods?"

Yan Yan smiled bitterly.

On the side, the old man from the Hun Gu Star Region wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and nodded.

"I'm afraid it is. We have arrived in the deserted city, so try to be careful."

This deserted city is really too scary.

And at this moment, another terrifying martial arts aura suddenly surged out from the Xuanling Star Region.

Feeling this martial arts aura.

The two of them suddenly lost their voices and said: "Martial God!"

Jiangbei!

What the two didn't know was that Jiang Bei was not a martial arts god now, but he had already reached the martial arts god level when he was in the Divine Emperor realm!

And now, Jiang Bei's aura was surprisingly at the super-god level, and the horror of the martial arts god was fully displayed at this moment.
